supported_scope: project-owned C compiler frontend, SSA IR, optimization passes, and host backend
debug, release, and sanitizer build modes defined by Makefile
excluded_scope: sandboxing of compiler inputs or generated programs
compatibility beyond behavior exercised by the checked-in test suite
root HTML and assembly diagnostic artifacts as release products
update_strategy: Owner-reviewed commits; run make test for every change; update this baseline when intentionally cutting an internal release; independently review any imported third-party code.

license.policy: No external distribution or product extraction until the owner adds an explicit license.
